experimentDetails.lightMethod: The greenhouse lamp is treated as a red-blue mixture: 63.6% red and 36.4% blue, estimated from the EKO-LED nominal luminous intensities R 700 mcd and B 400 mcd. Formula: PPFD = lux × CF. The estimated lamp factor is (63.6% × 0.0242) + (36.4% × 0.0662) = 0.0395. This is an estimate, not a calibrated PAR measurement.
